paragraphs: I'm applying for the Software Engineer role at Stanford University. I was drawn to your work in developing AI modules for verbal individuals on the autism spectrum.

At a previous role, I engineered a solution that consolidated diverse enterprise systems—including Rapid7, Jamf, and BigFix—into a unified platform. I automated the end-to-end workflow from data aggregation to remediation, which reduced manual effort by over 100 hours per month and improved the organization's visibility and response capabilities across thousands of endpoints.

Earlier, I developed custom automation and tooling to analyze system behavior, identify anomalies, and harden production environments. These projects leaned on the same foundations you need: robust system architecture, strong authentication and secrets management, and disciplined monitoring and alerting to maintain high availability and performance. I am also experienced in prompt engineering and fine-tuning LLMs.
If your mandate is to build reliable, secure, and scalable software that solves complex problems in AI and autism research, I would like to help you ship that.
